name.ja: 30MM 1/144 eEXM-17 アルト(陸戦仕様)[オリーブドラブ]

description.ja: 30MMシリーズ「eEXM-17 アルト(陸戦仕様）」にオリーブドラブが登場！
description.en: Olive Drab is now available in the 30MM series "eEXM-17 Alto (Land Battle Specification)"!

description.ja: ■別売りの他色アイテムとカラーミキシングしてオリジナルの機体を演出せよ！
description.en: • Create an original aircraft by color mixing with other color items sold separately!

description.ja: ■タンク形態を自分好みに組み替え可能。
description.en: • You can rearrange the tank form to your liking.

description.ja: ■陸戦用覆帯付きバックパック、マッシブレッグなどの新装備が付属。
description.en: • Comes with new equipment such as a backpack with a ground cover and massive legs.

description.ja: ■組み替え可能なバズーカも付属。
description.en: • A reconfigurable bazooka is also included.

description.ja: ■追加パーツはポルタノヴァにも装備可能。
description.en: • Additional parts can also be equipped on Portanova.

accessories.ja: 陸戦用バックパック/装甲×1式
